title: Set Up Python and a Code Editor Quiz
description: Check your understanding of Set Up Python and a Code Editor.

questions.question: Why do we install Python before writing Python programs?

options.text: Because Python runs the code we write.
Because Python is only used to draw pictures.
Because Python files cannot be saved without it.

questions.explanation: Python is the program that understands and executes Python code.

questions.question: Which file extension is commonly used for Python files?
questions.explanation: Python source files usually use the .py extension.

questions.question: Why is a code editor useful?

options.text: It helps you write, organize, and run code more easily.
It automatically writes every program for you.
It deletes errors without showing them.

questions.explanation: A code editor provides tools such as syntax highlighting, file management, and terminal integration.
